title: Characterization of norovirus GI.3 and GII.12 variants detected in wastewater: proof-of-concept for integrating phenotypic insights in wastewater-based epidemiology
abstract: ABSTRACT Norovirus is the leading cause of acute gastroenteritis, responsible for 685 million cases and 200,000 deaths annually. Wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE) enables not only global surveillance of dominant strains but also the detection of cryptic and emerging viral variants. An important question, however, is how to link genomic diversity to clinical impact and phenotypic traits of the strains detected in wastewater. In the Global Urban Wastewater Project, phylogenetically distinct norovirus GI.3 and GII.12 lineages were detected in wastewater from Cameroon. In this study, we characterized their host- and tissue-binding specificity and antigenic makeup in comparison with other GI.3 and GII.12 lineages using a luciferase immunoprecipitation system-based assay, alongside sequence analysis of the VP1 P2 subdomain. We observed intra-genotype variation among GI.3 variants. GI.3 Cameroon/2017 shared phenotypes with its closest reference strain (GI.3 Mexico/2016), and their histo-blood group antigen (HBGA)-binding profiles suggested a narrower susceptible population compared to other GI.3 lineages. Conversely, GII.12 strains showed no significant differences in HBGA binding, antigenic profiles, and tissue attachment. Together, these results reveal distinct patterns of phenotypic diversity between the two genotypes. While GI.3 variants exhibited lineage-specific traits, the GII.12 strains appeared phenotypically conserved across lineages. These findings highlight the feasibility and importance of integrating phenotypic analysis with WBE to assess potential public health risks posed by novel viral variants. IMPORTANCE While detection of norovirus through case-based surveillance is limited to variants causing symptomatic infection, wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE) allows for detection of cryptic and emerging variants. However, validation, such as phenotypic characterization, is needed to assess the clinical importance of a variant detected in WBE. In this study, we investigated the phenotypic traits of genetically distinct GI.3 and GII.12 lineages detected in wastewater from Cameroon. We utilized NanoLuc luciferase immunoprecipitation system (N-LIPS)-based assays to assess binding specificity and antigenicity. Compared to traditional methods involving virus isolation and virus-like particle production, N-LIPS-based assays are considerably less laborious and faster. This allows for rapid characterization of novel variants, making the timely assessment of phenotypic changes of such variants for outbreak or pandemic preparedness feasible. Finally, by integrating insights from phenotypic assays, we showed the possibility of expanding the public health value of wastewater surveillance in assessing the risk of novel viral variants.

analysis_zh.main_results: 我们观察到 GI.3 变体之间的基因型内变异。GI.3喀麦隆/2017与其最接近的参考菌株(GI.3墨西哥/2016)具有相同的表型,并且它们的组织血型抗原(HBGA)结合谱表明与其他GI.3谱系相比,易感人群范围更窄。相反,GII.12 菌株在 HBGA 结合、抗原谱和组织附着方面没有显着差异。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现强调了将表型分析与 WBE 相结合来评估新型病毒变异体带来的潜在公共卫生风险的可行性和重要性。这些结果揭示了两种基因型之间不同的表型多样性模式。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,将表型分析与基于废水的 流行病学 相结合可以增强 流行病学 在评估新型病毒变异风险方面的公共卫生价值。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于喀麦隆的废水样本,这可能会影响普适性。所提供的证据并未报告有关样本量、对照或偏倚的限制。

title: A seven-valent norovirus mRNA vaccine elicits robust humoral responses in preclinical models
abstract: ABSTRACT Noroviruses are a leading cause of acute gastroenteritis and impose a substantial global disease burden, particularly in children younger than 5 years and in older adults. Although multiple vaccine candidates are in preclinical and clinical development, no targeted intervention has been approved. We previously reported that a pentavalent mRNA vaccine candidate encoding VP1 proteins from genotypes GI.1, GII.2, GII.3, GII.4, and GII.6 elicited robust humoral and cellular immune responses in mice and nonhuman primates. Because recent surveillance data indicate increasing prevalence of GI.3 and GII.17, we designed mRNAs targeting these genotypes and evaluated an expanded seven-valent formulation in preclinical studies. We first compared candidate GI.3 and GII.17 strains in mice and selected vaccine components based on immunogenicity and cross-reactivity. The resulting seven-valent mRNA vaccine elicited strong humoral responses in mice and African green monkeys, including serum IgG binding to norovirus virus-like particles (VLPs) and functional antibodies that blocked VLP binding to histo-blood group antigens (HBGAs). Importantly, incorporation of GI.3 and GII.17 broadened functional coverage, whereas multivalent formulation introduced only limited evidence of immune interference. These findings support the feasibility of surveillance-guided updating of multivalent norovirus mRNA vaccines and highlight the adaptability of the mRNA platform for addressing emerging variants. IMPORTANCE Norovirus is a major cause of vomiting and diarrhea worldwide, but developing a broadly protective vaccine is difficult because many genetically distinct strains circulate, and their prevalence changes over time. This study demonstrates a flexible vaccine strategy in which mRNA components can be selected and added based on disease surveillance and experimental evidence. We expanded a five-component norovirus vaccine to include GI.3 and GII.17, two increasingly important genotypes. The resulting seven-component vaccine generated strong antibody responses in mice and African green monkeys and broadened the range of virus types targeted by functional antibodies. Although additional studies are needed to determine whether these responses protect humans, the findings show how the adaptability of mRNA technology could support periodic updates of multivalent norovirus vaccines as circulating strains change.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Noroviruses are a leading cause of acute gastroenteritis and impose a substantial global disease burden, particularly in children younger than 5 years and in older adults. No targeted intervention has been approved despite multiple vaccine candidates in preclinical and clinical development.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study evaluated a seven-valent norovirus mRNA vaccine in preclinical models, specifically mice and African green monkeys, following the expansion of a five-component vaccine to include GI.3 and GII.17 genotypes.
analysis.methods: The researchers designed mRNAs targeting GI.3 and GII.17 genotypes based on surveillance data and compared candidate strains in mice to select vaccine components. They then assessed the immunogenicity of the seven-valent formulation in mice and African green monkeys.
analysis.main_results: The seven-valent mRNA vaccine elicited strong humoral responses in mice and African green monkeys, including serum IgG binding to norovirus virus-like particles (VLPs) and functional antibodies that blocked VLP binding to histo-blood group antigens (HBGAs).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study demonstrates that incorporating new genotypes into a multivalent mRNA vaccine can broaden functional coverage without introducing significant immune interference.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings support the feasibility of using surveillance data to update multivalent norovirus mRNA vaccines, which could enhance protection against emerging variants.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to preclinical models, and additional research is needed to determine whether these responses translate to human protection. The evidence is moderate due to the reliance on animal models.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the development of a seven-valent norovirus mRNA vaccine, expanding a previously reported pentavalent formulation to include GI.3 and GII.17 genotypes. The researchers designed the vaccine based on surveillance data indicating the increasing prevalence of these strains and evaluated its immunogenicity in mice and African green monkeys. The vaccine elicited strong humoral responses, including IgG binding to virus-like particles (VLPs) and functional antibodies that blocked VLP binding to histo-blood group antigens (HBGAs). The results suggest that incorporating new genotypes can broaden vaccine coverage without significant immune interference. While the findings support the adaptability of mRNA technology for vaccine updates, the study is limited to preclinical models, and further research is needed to assess human efficacy. The evidence is moderate, as the study does not provide direct human data.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 诺如病毒 是 急性胃肠炎 的主要原因,给全球带来了巨大的疾病负担,特别是对于 5 岁以下的儿童和老年人。尽管有多个 疫苗 候选药物处于临床前和临床开发阶段,但尚未批准有针对性的干预措施。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究在将五组分 疫苗 扩展至包括 GI.3 和 GII.17 基因型后,在临床前模型(特别是小鼠和非洲绿猴)中评估了七价 诺如病毒 mRNA 疫苗。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员根据监测数据设计了针对GI.3和GII.17基因型的mRNA,并在小鼠体内比较候选菌株以选择疫苗成分。然后他们评估了七价制剂在小鼠和非洲绿猴中的免疫原性。
elements_zh.main_results: 七价 mRNA 疫苗 在小鼠和非洲绿猴中引发了强烈的体液反应,包括与 诺如病毒 病毒样颗粒 (VLP) 结合的血清 IgG 以及阻止 VLP 与组织血型抗原 (HBGA) 结合的功能性抗体。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究表明,将新基因型纳入多价 mRNA 疫苗 可以扩大功能覆盖范围,而不会引入显着的免疫干扰。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果支持使用 监测 数据更新多价 诺如病毒 mRNA 疫苗 的可行性,这可以增强对新出现变异的保护。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于临床前模型,需要进行更多研究来确定这些反应是否转化为人类保护。由于依赖动物模型,证据不充分。

title_zh: 七价 诺如病毒 mRNA 疫苗 在临床前模型中引发强烈的体液反应
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Noroviruses are a leading cause of acute gastroenteritis and impose a substantial global disease burden, particularly in children younger than 5 years and in older adults. Although multiple vaccine candidates are in preclinical and clinical development, no targeted intervention has been approved. We previously reported that a pentavalent mRNA vaccine candidate encoding VP1 proteins from genotypes GI.1, GII.2, GII.3, GII.4, and GII.6 elicited robust humoral and cellular immune responses in mice and nonhuman primates. Because recent surveillance data indicate increasing prevalence of GI.3 and GII.17, we designed mRNAs targeting these genotypes and evaluated an expanded seven-valent formulation in preclinical studies. We first compared candidate GI.3 and GII.17 strains in mice and selected vaccine components based on immunogenicity and cross-reactivity. The resulting seven-valent mRNA vaccine elicited strong humoral responses in mice and African green monkeys, including serum IgG binding to norovirus virus-like particles (VLPs) and functional antibodies that blocked VLP binding to histo-blood group antigens (HBGAs). Importantly, incorporation of GI.3 and GII.17 broadened functional coverage, whereas multivalent formulation introduced only limited evidence of immune interference. These findings support the feasibility of surveillance-guided updating of multivalent norovirus mRNA vaccines and highlight the adaptability of the mRNA platform for addressing emerging variants. IMPORTANCE Norovirus is a major cause of vomiting and diarrhea worldwide, but developing a broadly protective vaccine is difficult because many genetically distinct strains circulate, and their prevalence changes over time. This study demonstrates a flexible vaccine strategy in which mRNA components can be selected and added based on disease surveillance and experimental evidence. We expanded a five-component norovirus vaccine to include GI.3 and GII.17, two increasingly important genotypes. The resulting seven-component vaccine generated strong antibody responses in mice and African green monkeys and broadened the range of virus types targeted by functional antibodies. Although additional studies are needed to determine whether these responses protect humans, the findings show how the adaptability of mRNA technology could support periodic updates of multivalent norovirus vaccines as circulating strains change.

title: Synthesis of Fluorinated 2'-Fucosyllactose Analogues: Investigating the Roles of Primary and Anomeric Hydroxyl Groups in Norovirus Recognition.
abstract: Human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs) inhibit norovirus attachment by acting as soluble decoy ligands. 2'-Fucosyllactose (2'-FL) is the most abundant component of HMOs and also one of the most studied, yet the contribution of individual hydroxyl groups in 2'-FL to molecular recognition remains unclear. To probe their roles, we synthesized a series of monofluorinated, difluorinated, and trifluoroethyl-substituted 2'-FL analogues bearing modifications at the primary and anomeric positions. The dissociation constants (Kd) of the fluorinated analogues toward the GII.4 Sydney norovirus P-domain were determined by chemical shift perturbation (CSP) NMR spectroscopy. All fluorinated derivatives exhibited binding affinities comparable to native 2'-FL, indicating that fluorination at these positions does not significantly perturb ligand recognition. These findings indicate that fluorination at the primary and anomeric positions of 2'-FL is well tolerated by the GII.4 Sydney norovirus P-domain, highlighting the utility of fluorinated 2'-FL analogues for probing carbohydrate-protein interactions.

To probe their roles, we synthesized a series of monofluorinated, difluorinated, and trifluoroethyl-substituted 2'-FL analogues bearing modifications at the primary and anomeric positions. The dissociation constants (Kd) of the fluorinated analogues toward the GII.4 Sydney norovirus P-domain were determined by chemical shift perturbation (CSP) NMR spectroscopy. All fluorinated derivatives exhibited binding affinities comparable to native 2'-FL, indicating that fluorination at these positions does not significantly perturb ligand recognition. These findings indicate that fluorination at the primary and anomeric positions of 2'-FL is well tolerated by the GII.4 Sydney norovirus P-domain, highlighting the utility of fluorinated 2'-FL analogues for probing carbohydrate-protein interactions.
abstract_zh: 人乳寡糖 (HMO) 通过充当可溶性诱饵配体来抑制 诺如病毒 附着。2'-岩藻糖基乳糖 (2'-FL) 是 HMO 中最丰富的成分,也是研究最多的成分之一,但 2'-FL 中各个羟基对分子识别的贡献仍不清楚。为了探究它们的作用,我们合成了一系列在初级和异头位置带有修饰的单氟化、二氟化和三氟乙基取代的2'-FL类似物。通过化学位移微扰 (CSP) NMR 光谱测定氟化类似物对 GII.4 Sydney 诺如病毒 P 结构域的解离常数 (Kd)。所有氟化衍生物均表现出与天然 2'-FL 相当的结合亲和力,表明这些位置的氟化不会显着干扰配体识别。这些发现表明,GII.4 Sydney 诺如病毒 P 结构域能够很好地耐受 2'-FL 的初级和异头位置上的氟化,这凸显了氟化 2'-FL 类似物在探测碳水化合物-蛋白质相互作用方面的实用性。

title: Human norovirus infection does not induce serotonin secretion in human intestinal organoids
abstract: ABSTRACT Human noroviruses (HuNoVs) are a leading cause of acute gastroenteritis worldwide. The primary symptoms of HuNoV-associated disease are vomiting and diarrhea; yet the mechanisms underlying these symptoms are poorly understood. Neuroactive hormones such as serotonin (5-hydroxytryptamine; 5-HT) secreted by intestinal enteroendocrine cells (EECs) can activate vomiting centers in the brain and play a critical role in regulating emetic signaling. Serotonin release from infected EECs has been implicated in vomiting during other enteric infections. Recent studies have reported the detection of HuNoV RNA and antigen in EECs in jejunal biopsies from immunocompromised patients with chronic HuNoV infection and rhesus macaques. We therefore investigated whether HuNoV infection of human intestinal organoids (HIOs) induces serotonin secretion. We examined infection and serotonin secretion with multiple genogroup II HuNoV strains using adult and infant jejunal HIO models, including a doxycycline-inducible neurogenin-3 HIO line with increased numbers of EECs. HuNoV infection did not induce serotonin secretion in either adult or infant HIOs as measured by ELISA. Consistent with enterocytes being the primary target cell type for HuNoVs, GII.4 HuNoV replication was robust in parental HIOs but reduced in EEC-enriched cultures. Furthermore, supernatants from parental HIOs failed to stimulate serotonin release from EEC-enriched HIOs. Together, these findings demonstrate that HuNoV infection of intestinal epithelial cells is insufficient to trigger serotonin release in HIOs. These results suggest that HuNoV-associated vomiting is unlikely to result from direct epithelial serotonin secretion and may require additional cellular components such as immune or neuronal signaling pathways or may involve other neuroactive hormones. IMPORTANCE Vomiting is a hallmark symptom of human norovirus disease. Yet, the biological mechanisms responsible for this response are unknown. Infection of enteroendocrine cells and secretion of serotonin play key roles in the emetic response to other gastrointestinal viruses such as rotavirus. Since recent studies have detected human norovirus antigens and RNA in enteroendocrine cells, we hypothesized that human norovirus infection could stimulate serotonin secretion. We used jejunal human intestinal organoids from adults and infants, including organoids enriched for enteroendocrine cells, and found that infection with several clinically important strains did not induce serotonin secretion, even under conditions supporting robust viral replication. These data indicate that serotonin release from intestinal epithelial cells alone is unlikely to explain norovirus-induced vomiting and highlights the need to investigate alternative mechanisms, including other neuroactive hormones, and neuronal signaling pathways to better understand the pathogenesis of norovirus-associated vomiting.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Human noroviruses (HuNoVs) are a leading cause of acute gastroenteritis worldwide, and the mechanisms underlying their primary symptoms of vomiting and diarrhea remain poorly understood. Neuroactive hormones such as serotonin (5-HT) secreted by intestinal enteroendocrine cells (EECs) can activate vomiting centers in the brain and are implicated in vomiting during other enteric infections.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study investigated whether HuNoV infection of human intestinal organoids (HIOs) induces serotonin secretion. It used adult and infant jejunal HIO models, including a doxycycline-inducible neurogenin-3 HIO line with increased numbers of EECs.
analysis.methods: HuNoV infection was assessed using jejunal human intestinal organoids from adults and infants, including those enriched for enteroendocrine cells. Serotonin secretion was measured by ELISA, and viral replication was evaluated in parental HIOs and EEC-enriched cultures.
analysis.main_results: HuNoV infection did not induce serotonin secretion in either adult or infant HIOs, even under conditions supporting robust viral replication. GII.4 HuNoV replication was robust in parental HIOs but reduced in EEC-enriched cultures. Supernatants from parental HIOs failed to stimulate serotonin release from EEC-enriched HIOs.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: These results suggest that HuNoV-associated vomiting is unlikely to result from direct epithelial serotonin secretion and may require additional cellular components such as immune or neuronal signaling pathways or may involve other neuroactive hormones.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings demonstrate that serotonin release from intestinal epithelial cells alone is insufficient to explain norovirus-induced vomiting, highlighting the need to explore alternative mechanisms such as immune or neuronal signaling pathways to better understand the pathogenesis of norovirus-associated vomiting.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study used human intestinal organoids as a model system, which may not fully replicate in vivo conditions. The evidence is moderate, as the findings are based on in vitro experiments and do not account for complex host interactions in vivo.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates whether human norovirus (HuNoV) infection of human intestinal organoids (HIOs) induces serotonin secretion, a potential mechanism for vomiting. The research is motivated by the observation that serotonin release from infected enteroendocrine cells (EECs) has been implicated in vomiting during other enteric infections, such as rotavirus. Using HIOs from adults and infants, including EEC-enriched models, the study found that HuNoV infection did not trigger serotonin secretion, even when viral replication was robust. These results suggest that HuNoV-induced vomiting may not be directly caused by EEC-derived serotonin and may involve other pathways. The findings have implications for understanding the pathogenesis of norovirus-associated vomiting and emphasize the need to explore alternative mechanisms. The study's evidence is moderate due to its reliance on in vitro models and the absence of in vivo data.

elements_en.research_question_and_background: Human noroviruses (HuNoVs) are a leading cause of acute gastroenteritis worldwide, and the mechanisms underlying their primary symptoms of vomiting and diarrhea remain poorly understood. Neuroactive hormones such as serotonin (5-HT) secreted by intestinal enteroendocrine cells (EECs) can activate vomiting centers in the brain and are implicated in vomiting during other enteric infections.
elements_en.study_design_and_population: The study investigated whether HuNoV infection of human intestinal organoids (HIOs) induces serotonin secretion. It used adult and infant jejunal HIO models, including a doxycycline-inducible neurogenin-3 HIO line with increased numbers of EECs.
elements_en.methods: HuNoV infection was assessed using jejunal human intestinal organoids from adults and infants, including those enriched for enteroendocrine cells. Serotonin secretion was measured by ELISA, and viral replication was evaluated in parental HIOs and EEC-enriched cultures.
elements_en.main_results: HuNoV infection did not induce serotonin secretion in either adult or infant HIOs, even under conditions supporting robust viral replication. GII.4 HuNoV replication was robust in parental HIOs but reduced in EEC-enriched cultures. Supernatants from parental HIOs failed to stimulate serotonin release from EEC-enriched HIOs.
elements_en.interpretation_and_novelty: These results suggest that HuNoV-associated vomiting is unlikely to result from direct epithelial serotonin secretion and may require additional cellular components such as immune or neuronal signaling pathways or may involve other neuroactive hormones.
elements_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings demonstrate that serotonin release from intestinal epithelial cells alone is insufficient to explain norovirus-induced vomiting, highlighting the need to explore alternative mechanisms such as immune or neuronal signaling pathways to better understand the pathogenesis of norovirus-associated vomiting.
elements_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study used human intestinal organoids as a model system, which may not fully replicate in vivo conditions. The evidence is moderate, as the findings are based on in vitro experiments and do not account for complex host interactions in vivo.

title_zh: 人类诺如病毒感染不会在人类肠道类器官中诱导血清素分泌
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Human noroviruses (HuNoVs) are a leading cause of acute gastroenteritis worldwide. The primary symptoms of HuNoV-associated disease are vomiting and diarrhea; yet the mechanisms underlying these symptoms are poorly understood. Neuroactive hormones such as serotonin (5-hydroxytryptamine; 5-HT) secreted by intestinal enteroendocrine cells (EECs) can activate vomiting centers in the brain and play a critical role in regulating emetic signaling. Serotonin release from infected EECs has been implicated in vomiting during other enteric infections. Recent studies have reported the detection of HuNoV RNA and antigen in EECs in jejunal biopsies from immunocompromised patients with chronic HuNoV infection and rhesus macaques. We therefore investigated whether HuNoV infection of human intestinal organoids (HIOs) induces serotonin secretion. We examined infection and serotonin secretion with multiple genogroup II HuNoV strains using adult and infant jejunal HIO models, including a doxycycline-inducible neurogenin-3 HIO line with increased numbers of EECs. HuNoV infection did not induce serotonin secretion in either adult or infant HIOs as measured by ELISA. Consistent with enterocytes being the primary target cell type for HuNoVs, GII.4 HuNoV replication was robust in parental HIOs but reduced in EEC-enriched cultures. Furthermore, supernatants from parental HIOs failed to stimulate serotonin release from EEC-enriched HIOs. Together, these findings demonstrate that HuNoV infection of intestinal epithelial cells is insufficient to trigger serotonin release in HIOs. These results suggest that HuNoV-associated vomiting is unlikely to result from direct epithelial serotonin secretion and may require additional cellular components such as immune or neuronal signaling pathways or may involve other neuroactive hormones. IMPORTANCE Vomiting is a hallmark symptom of human norovirus disease. Yet, the biological mechanisms responsible for this response are unknown. Infection of enteroendocrine cells and secretion of serotonin play key roles in the emetic response to other gastrointestinal viruses such as rotavirus. Since recent studies have detected human norovirus antigens and RNA in enteroendocrine cells, we hypothesized that human norovirus infection could stimulate serotonin secretion. We used jejunal human intestinal organoids from adults and infants, including organoids enriched for enteroendocrine cells, and found that infection with several clinically important strains did not induce serotonin secretion, even under conditions supporting robust viral replication. These data indicate that serotonin release from intestinal epithelial cells alone is unlikely to explain norovirus-induced vomiting and highlights the need to investigate alternative mechanisms, including other neuroactive hormones, and neuronal signaling pathways to better understand the pathogenesis of norovirus-associated vomiting.
abstract_zh: 摘要 人类诺如病毒(HuNoVs)是全球急性胃肠炎的主要病因之一。HuNoV相关疾病的主要症状是呕吐和腹泻;然而,这些症状的发病机制仍不清楚。肠道内分泌细胞(EECs)分泌的神经活性激素如血清素(5-羟基色胺;5-HT)可以激活大脑中的呕吐中枢,并在调节呕吐信号中起关键作用。在其他肠道感染中,受感染的EECs释放血清素已被认为与呕吐有关。最近的研究报告称,在免疫功能低下且患有慢性HuNoV感染的患者以及恒河猴的空肠活检中检测到了HuNoV RNA和抗原。因此,我们研究了HuNoV感染是否会导致人类肠道类器官(HIOs)中的血清素分泌。我们使用成人和婴儿空肠HIO模型,包括一种四环素诱导的神经元生成素-3 HIO系,该系中EECs数量增加,来检测感染和血清素分泌情况。通过ELISA检测发现,无论是成人还是婴儿HIOs,HuNoV感染均未诱导血清素分泌。这与肠上皮细胞是HuNoV主要靶细胞类型一致,GII.4 HuNoV在亲本HIOs中复制旺盛,但在富含EECs的培养物中复制减少。此外,亲本HIOs的上清液未能刺激富含EECs的HIOs释放血清素。综上所述,这些发现表明HuNoV感染肠道上皮细胞不足以在HIOs中触发血清素释放。这些结果提示HuNoV相关的呕吐不太可能由直接的上皮血清素分泌引起,可能需要其他细胞成分,如免疫或神经信号通路,或者涉及其他神经活性激素。重要性 呕吐是人类诺如病毒疾病的一个标志性症状。然而,导致这种反应的生物学机制尚不清楚。在其他胃肠道病毒如轮状病毒的呕吐反应中,肠道内分泌细胞的感染和血清素的分泌起着关键作用。由于最近的研究在肠道内分泌细胞中检测到了人类诺如病毒抗原和RNA,我们假设人类诺如病毒感染可能刺激血清素分泌。我们使用了成人和婴儿的空肠类器官,包括富含肠道内分泌细胞的类器官,并发现几种临床重要的毒株感染并未诱导血清素分泌,即使在支持病毒高效复制的条件下也是如此。这些数据表明,仅由肠道上皮细胞释放血清素不足以解释诺如病毒引起的呕吐,强调了需要探索其他机制,包括其他神经活性激素和神经信号通路,以更好地理解诺如病毒相关呕吐的发病机制。

title: Rhodococcus–norovirus interactions: a hypothesis of affinity-driven viral release from bacterial exopolysaccharides
abstract: Recent findings have revealed that Rhodococcus species bind human norovirus (NoV) particles in clinical stool samples collected from pediatric gastroenteritis cases. This recurring association across independent samples suggests a potentially relevant biological interaction. The binding appears to be mediated by exopolysaccharides (EPSs), which are typically rich in fucose, galactose, and glucuronic acid residues and may structurally mimic histo-blood group antigens (HBGAs), the known cellular receptors for NoV. We propose that these EPSs may function as transient viral carriers capable of stabilizing virions while maintaining reversible interactions with the viral capsid. We further hypothesize an affinity-driven release mechanism, whereby authentic HBGAs on host epithelial cells, possessing higher binding affinity, displace virions from bacterial EPSs, thereby facilitating timely infection. This interaction may serve a dual function: Environmental stabilization of the virus and its controlled release upon encountering host cells. If validated, this model would support the concept that bacterial glycans act as dynamic, reversible docking platforms that influence NoV ecology, transmission, and infectivity.

abstract_zh: 最近的研究结果表明,从儿科胃肠炎病例收集的临床粪便样本中,红球菌属与人类 诺如病毒 (NoV) 颗粒结合。独立样本之间的这种反复出现的关联表明存在潜在相关的生物相互作用。这种结合似乎是由胞外多糖(EPS)介导的,胞外多糖通常富含岩藻糖、半乳糖和葡萄糖醛酸残基,并且可能在结构上模仿组织血型抗原(HBGA),即NoV的已知细胞受体。我们认为这些 EPS 可能作为瞬时病毒载体,能够稳定病毒粒子,同时保持与病毒衣壳的可逆相互作用。我们进一步假设了一种亲和力驱动的释放机制,即 宿主 上皮细胞上的真实 HBGA 具有更高的结合亲和力,可以取代细菌 EPS 中的病毒颗粒,从而促进及时感染。这种相互作用可能具有双重功能:病毒的环境稳定及其在遇到 宿主 细胞时的受控释放。如果得到验证,该模型将支持细菌聚糖作为影响 NoV 生态、传播 和感染性的动态、可逆对接平台的概念。

title: Near-complete genome sequences of five norovirus GII.4[P31] strains from coastal Kenya, 2019
abstract: ABSTRACT There is limited norovirus genomic data from Africa. We report five near-complete norovirus genomes of genotype GII.4[P31], recovered from stool samples of children admitted with acute diarrhea in coastal Kenya during 2019. These expand the available genomic data resource for norovirus evolutionary studies, molecular assay improvement, and therapeutics development.

The research aimed to address the limited genomic data available for norovirus in Africa, which is crucial for understanding its genetic diversity and evolution. The methods involved sequencing viral genomes from stool samples, which expanded the genomic data resource for norovirus evolutionary studies, molecular assay improvement, and therapeutics development. The main results included the successful recovery of five near-complete genomes, contributing to the genetic database of norovirus in the region. The findings highlight the importance of these sequences for improving surveillance and diagnostic tools in African populations. The study's limitations include its focus on a single region and genotype, but the evidence is strong due to the direct genomic data obtained. The results have significant implications for public health, particularly in the context of norovirus gastroenteritis, and provide a foundation for future research on the virus in Africa.

title: Single-cell profiling of the duodenum during chronic human norovirus infection
abstract: Human noroviruses are a major cause of diarrheal disease, yet their pathogenesis remains poorly defined. We performed single-cell RNA sequencing of duodenal biopsies and matched stem cell–derived enteroids from immunodeficient individuals with chronic norovirus infection. Norovirus RNA was detected primarily in enterocytes, enteroendocrine cells, and macrophages, with the highest proportion of viral RNA-positive cells observed among M2 macrophages, followed by late enterocytes. Despite this distribution, late enterocytes produced higher viral yields than differentiated M2 macrophages in vitro. Norovirus infection was associated with the up-regulation of MHC class I-related genes and IL15 in duodenal macrophages and late enterocytes, together with increased IFNG expression by CD8 T cells. Macrophages and late enterocytes up-regulated CXCL9 and CXCL10/11 , respectively, consistent with CD8 and CD4 T cell recruitment to the duodenum. These findings show that noroviruses infect and persist across multiple permissive cell types during chronic infection, resulting in marked dysregulation of innate and adaptive immune responses that may drive pathogenesis.

title_zh: 人类 诺如病毒 慢性感染期间十二指肠的单细胞分析
source_body_en: Human noroviruses are a major cause of diarrheal disease, yet their pathogenesis remains poorly defined. We performed single-cell RNA sequencing of duodenal biopsies and matched stem cell–derived enteroids from immunodeficient individuals with chronic norovirus infection. Norovirus RNA was detected primarily in enterocytes, enteroendocrine cells, and macrophages, with the highest proportion of viral RNA-positive cells observed among M2 macrophages, followed by late enterocytes. Despite this distribution, late enterocytes produced higher viral yields than differentiated M2 macrophages in vitro. Macrophages and late enterocytes up-regulated CXCL9 and CXCL10/11 , respectively, consistent with CD8 and CD4 T cell recruitment to the duodenum. These findings show that noroviruses infect and persist across multiple permissive cell types during chronic infection, resulting in marked dysregulation of innate and adaptive immune responses that may drive pathogenesis.

title: Integrated molecular and epidemiological assessment of pediatric viral gastroenteritis using qRT-PCR versus rapid immunochromatographic diagnostics
abstract: Background: Viral gastroenteritis represents a major cause of pediatric morbidity, being one of the leading acute conditions requiring emergency care or hospitalization. Enteric viruses such as rotavirus, norovirus, adenovirus, astrovirus, and sapovirus are frequently implicated, with prevalence varying by age and season. The objective of this study was to assess the distribution of viral agents in children and to compare the performance of two diagnostic methods: immunochromatographic (ICT) and quantitative real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR). Materials and methods: In a retrospective study, a total of 164 children hospitalized with acute gastroenteritis between February 2023 and March 2025 were investigated using qRT-PCR and ICT methods. Results: The positivity rate for rotavirus, norovirus and adenovirus was 58.5% by qRT-PCR compared to 25.0% by ICT, with slightly higher rates in urban areas (62/103) and in females (54/73). The most affected age group was 1-3 years, with increased incidence during warm seasons. rotavirus was the predominant pathogen (66 cases by qRT-PCR; 32 by ICT), followed by norovirus (41 cases vs. 11), while viral co-infections accounted for 11% of cases. These findings highlight the importance of rapid and accurate etiological diagnosis for appropriate management, prevention of complications, and reduction of unnecessary antibiotic use. Conclusions: Our findings demonstrated a higher diagnostic performance of qRT-PCR compared with ICT, particularly for the detection of norovirus and rotavirus. Although rapid ICT tests may serve as an initial diagnostic tool in settings with limited access to molecular testing, qRT-PCR provides more reliable pathogen detection and may improve the accuracy of etiological diagnosis. However, the clinical impact of molecular testing on treatment decisions, antibiotic prescriptions, hospitalization duration, and patient outcomes was not assessed in this study.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The objective of this study was to assess the distribution of viral agents in children and to compare the performance of two diagnostic methods: immunochromatographic (ICT) and quantitative real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR). In a retrospective study, a total of 164 children hospitalized with acute gastroenteritis between February 2023 and March 2025 were investigated using qRT-PCR and ICT methods.
analysis.methods: rotavirus was the predominant pathogen (66 cases by qRT-PCR; 32 by ICT), followed by norovirus (41 cases vs. 11), while viral co-infections accounted for 11% of cases. Although rapid ICT tests may serve as an initial diagnostic tool in settings with limited access to molecular testing, qRT-PCR provides more reliable pathogen detection and may improve the accuracy of etiological diagnosis.
analysis.main_results: The positivity rate for rotavirus, norovirus and adenovirus was 58.5% by qRT-PCR compared to 25.0% by ICT, with slightly higher rates in urban areas (62/103) and in females (54/73). The most affected age group was 1-3 years, with increased incidence during warm seasons.

analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The study provides critical insights into the diagnostic accuracy of qRT-PCR for norovirus and rotavirus in pediatric gastroenteritis, which can inform improved surveillance and diagnostic strategies in clinical settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The clinical impact of molecular testing on treatment decisions, antibiotic prescriptions, hospitalization duration, and patient outcomes was not assessed in this study. analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic performance of qRT-PCR versus rapid immunochromatographic tests (ICT) for viral gastroenteritis in children. Conducted in a retrospective setting, it analyzed 164 hospitalized children between February 2023 and March 2025. qRT-PCR showed higher positivity rates for norovirus and rotavirus compared to ICT, with rotavirus being the most prevalent pathogen. The study highlights the importance of accurate diagnosis for managing pediatric gastroenteritis and reducing unnecessary antibiotic use. However, it does not assess the clinical impact of molecular testing on treatment decisions or patient outcomes. The evidence is moderate due to the retrospective design and lack of outcome evaluation.

title_zh: 使用 qRT-PCR 与快速免疫层析诊断对儿童病毒性胃肠炎进行综合分子和流行病学评估
source_body_en: Background: Viral gastroenteritis represents a major cause of pediatric morbidity, being one of the leading acute conditions requiring emergency care or hospitalization. Enteric viruses such as rotavirus, norovirus, adenovirus, astrovirus, and sapovirus are frequently implicated, with prevalence varying by age and season. The objective of this study was to assess the distribution of viral agents in children and to compare the performance of two diagnostic methods: immunochromatographic (ICT) and quantitative real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction (qRT-PCR). Materials and methods: In a retrospective study, a total of 164 children hospitalized with acute gastroenteritis between February 2023 and March 2025 were investigated using qRT-PCR and ICT methods. Results: The positivity rate for rotavirus, norovirus and adenovirus was 58.5% by qRT-PCR compared to 25.0% by ICT, with slightly higher rates in urban areas (62/103) and in females (54/73). The most affected age group was 1-3 years, with increased incidence during warm seasons. rotavirus was the predominant pathogen (66 cases by qRT-PCR; 32 by ICT), followed by norovirus (41 cases vs. 11), while viral co-infections accounted for 11% of cases. These findings highlight the importance of rapid and accurate etiological diagnosis for appropriate management, prevention of complications, and reduction of unnecessary antibiotic use. Conclusions: Our findings demonstrated a higher diagnostic performance of qRT-PCR compared with ICT, particularly for the detection of norovirus and rotavirus. Although rapid ICT tests may serve as an initial diagnostic tool in settings with limited access to molecular testing, qRT-PCR provides more reliable pathogen detection and may improve the accuracy of etiological diagnosis. However, the clinical impact of molecular testing on treatment decisions, antibiotic prescriptions, hospitalization duration, and patient outcomes was not assessed in this study.
abstract_zh: 背景:病毒性胃肠炎是儿科发病的主要原因,是需要紧急护理或住院治疗的主要急性病症之一。轮状病毒、诺如病毒、腺病毒、星状病毒和沙波病毒等肠道病毒经常受到影响,患病率 因年龄和季节而异。本研究的目的是评估儿童中病毒因子的分布,并比较两种诊断方法的性能:免疫层析(ICT)和定量实时逆转录聚合酶链反应(qRT-PCR)。材料和方法:在一项回顾性研究中,采用 qRT-PCR 和 ICT 方法对 2023 年 2 月至 2025 年 3 月期间因 急性胃肠炎 住院的 164 名儿童进行了调查。结果:qRT-PCR 检测轮状病毒、诺如病毒 和腺病毒的阳性率为 58.5%,而 ICT 检测的阳性率为 25.0%,其中城市地区 (62/103) 和女性 (54/73) 的阳性率略高。受影响最严重的年龄组是 1-3 岁,在温暖季节 发病率 增加。轮状病毒是主要病原体(qRT-PCR 检测 66 例;ICT 检测 32 例),其次是 诺如病毒(41 例 vs. 11 例),病毒合并感染占病例的 11%。这些发现强调了快速、准确的病因学 诊断 对于适当管理、预防并发症和减少不必要的抗生素使用的重要性。结论:我们的研究结果表明,与 ICT 相比,qRT-PCR 具有更高的诊断性能,特别是在 诺如病毒 和轮状病毒的检测方面。尽管快速 ICT 检测可作为分子检测机会有限的环境中的初始诊断工具,但 qRT-PCR 提供更可靠的病原体检测,并可提高病原学 诊断 的准确性。然而,本研究并未评估分子检测对 治疗 决策、抗生素处方、住院时间和患者结果的临床影响。

title: Impact to Healthcare-Associated Viral Gastroenteritis Infection Rate Using Different Visitation Models in a Pediatric Hospital.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Pediatric healthcare-associated viral gastroenteritis infections (HA-VGI) contribute to morbidity, prolonged hospitalization, and outbreaks. Visitor-related transmission is a recognized risk factor; associations between visitation models and HA-VGI incidence remain understudied. METHODS: HA-VGI rates were compared across four visitation models: (Period 1) seasonal visitation, visitors <13 years restricted December 1-April 30; (Period 2) two legally authorized representatives (LAR) permitted, mandatory masking; (Period 3) masking with an LAR-approved 10-person visitor list, including siblings; (Period 4) identical visitation model without masking (December 2017-June 2025). HA-VGI was defined as gastroenteritis on or after hospital day 3. Changepoint analysis, interrupted time series modeling, nonparametric comparisons, and multivariable linear regression assessed differences across periods. Regression models adjusted for community GI viral activity and calendar month. Rates were compared by unit and pathogen. RESULTS: Median HA-VGI rates declined significantly during Period 2 compared with Period 1 (0.93 vs. 5.14 per 10,000 patient days; p<0.001). Although rates increased in Period 3, they remained below Period 1. Adjusted regression demonstrated lower rates during Periods 2 and 3 than during Period 1 (β=-3.01 and -3.07, respectively; both p<0.001). Period 4 did not significantly differ from Period 1. Community GI viral activity was independently associated with HA-VGI rates (β=5.94; p=0.002). ICU rates were lower than non-ICU rates; norovirus predominated. CONCLUSIONS: Year-round sibling visitation with visitor limits was not associated with increased HA-VGI incidence compared to seasonal visitation. Mandatory masking was associated with lower HA-VGI rates independent of community viral activity and seasonality and may provide protection during increased GI viral circulation.

abstract_original: BACKGROUND: Pediatric healthcare-associated viral gastroenteritis infections (HA-VGI) contribute to morbidity, prolonged hospitalization, and outbreaks. Visitor-related transmission is a recognized risk factor; associations between visitation models and HA-VGI incidence remain understudied. METHODS: HA-VGI rates were compared across four visitation models: (Period 1) seasonal visitation, visitors <13 years restricted December 1-April 30; (Period 2) two legally authorized representatives (LAR) permitted, mandatory masking; (Period 3) masking with an LAR-approved 10-person visitor list, including siblings; (Period 4) identical visitation model without masking (December 2017-June 2025). HA-VGI was defined as gastroenteritis on or after hospital day 3. Regression models adjusted for community GI viral activity and calendar month. Rates were compared by unit and pathogen. RESULTS: Median HA-VGI rates declined significantly during Period 2 compared with Period 1 (0.93 vs. 5.14 per 10,000 patient days; p<0.001). Mandatory masking was associated with lower HA-VGI rates independent of community viral activity and seasonality and may provide protection during increased GI viral circulation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 儿科医疗相关病毒性胃肠炎感染 (HA-VGI) 会导致发病、住院时间延长和 暴发。与访客相关的 传播 是公认的风险因素;访问模型和 HA-VGI 发病率 之间的关联仍未得到充分研究。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 比较了四种访问模式的 HA-VGI 率:(第 1 期)季节性访问,13 岁以下的访问者限制在 12 月 1 日至 4 月 30 日;(第 2 阶段)两名合法授权代表 (LAR) 允许,强制屏蔽;(第 3 阶段)使用 LAR 批准的 10 人访客名单进行掩饰,其中包括兄弟姐妹;(第 4 期)无掩蔽的相同访问模型(2017 年 12 月至 2025 年 6 月)。
elements_zh.methods: HA-VGI 被定义为住院第 3 天或之后的胃肠炎。变化点分析、中断时间序列建模、非参数比较和多变量线性回归评估了不同时期的差异。根据社区胃肠道病毒活动和日历月份调整回归模型。按单位和病原体比较比率。
elements_zh.main_results: 与第 1 阶段相比,第 2 阶段的中位 HA-VGI 率显着下降(每 10,000 患者日 0.93 对比 5.14;p<0.001)。尽管第 3 阶段的比率有所增加,但仍低于第 1 阶段。第 4 阶段与第 1 阶段没有显着差异。社区 GI 病毒活动与 HA-VGI 比率独立相关(β=5.94;p=0.002)。ICU 比率低于非 ICU 比率;诺如病毒 占主导地位。

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于观察数据,并未建立因果关系。由于缺乏随机对照试验且未充分考虑潜在的混杂因素,证据强度中等。

title: Acute diarrhea following the first subcutaneous dose of tafolecimab: a case report of a probable adverse drug reaction
abstract: Background Tafolecimab is a fully human monoclonal antibody targeting proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 9 (PCSK9). Diarrhea is a recognized adverse reaction, but detailed post-marketing case descriptions with clear timing, differential assessment, and outcome remain limited. Case Summary A 51-year-old man hospitalized for non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction received his first one-time 600-mg subcutaneous dose of tafolecimab (SINTBILO) at 15:14 on 13 July 2026. Approximately 7 h 46 min later, he developed abdominal pain and diarrhea occurring 5–8 times daily, with nausea and mild periumbilical pain but no fever, tenesmus, visible hematochezia or melena, dehydration, hypotension, rebound tenderness, or guarding. Stool testing showed loose yellow stool, positive occult blood and red blood cells, 0–1 white blood cells/high-power field, and a negative rotavirus test; electrolytes and liver and kidney function were normal. Stool culture and testing for Clostridioides difficile, norovirus, and adenovirus were not performed. Tafolecimab was not re-administered. After fluid replacement, montmorillonite, and loperamide hydrochloride, diarrhea decreased within 1 day and resolved after approximately 2 days, with no recurrence after discharge. Long-term stable acarbose therapy was continued without recurrence. The Naranjo score was 5, indicating a probable adverse drug reaction. Conclusion This case supports probable tafolecimab-associated acute diarrhea. New-onset diarrhea after PCSK9 inhibitor initiation should prompt precise temporal documentation, medication reconciliation, targeted microbiological evaluation, and pharmacovigilance reporting.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to report a case of acute diarrhea following the first subcutaneous dose of tafolecimab, highlighting the need for further investigation into potential adverse drug reactions associated with this PCSK9 inhibitor.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A case report was conducted on a 51-year-old man hospitalized for non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction who received his first 600-mg subcutaneous dose of tafolecimab on 13 July 2026.
analysis.methods: The patient's symptoms were documented, and stool testing was performed to assess for pathogens, including occult blood, red blood cells, and specific viral markers, while excluding tests for rotavirus, Clostridioides difficile, norovirus, and adenovirus.
analysis.main_results: The patient developed acute diarrhea 7 h 46 min after receiving tafolecimab, characterized by 5–8 episodes daily, with loose yellow stool, positive occult blood, and red blood cells, but no white blood cells, and a negative rotavirus test. Diarrhea resolved within 2 days after treatment with fluids, montmorillonite, and loperamide hydrochloride.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The case suggests a probable adverse drug reaction to tafolecimab, as supported by the Naranjo score of 5, and highlights the importance of monitoring for new-onset diarrhea following PCSK9 inhibitor initiation.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings emphasize the need for precise temporal documentation, medication reconciliation, targeted microbiological evaluation, and pharmacovigilance reporting in cases of new-onset diarrhea after PCSK9 inhibitor use.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to a single case report, which may not be generalizable. However, the Naranjo score of 5 provides a moderate level of confidence in the probable adverse drug reaction.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a 51-year-old man who developed acute diarrhea following his first subcutaneous dose of tafolecimab, a PCSK9 inhibitor, on 13 July 2026. The patient experienced 5–8 episodes of diarrhea daily, with loose yellow stool, positive occult blood, and red blood cells, but no white blood cells or rotavirus. Diarrhea resolved within 2 days after treatment with fluids, montmorillonite, and loperamide hydrochloride. The Naranjo score of 5 indicated a probable adverse drug reaction. The case underscores the importance of monitoring for new-onset diarrhea after PCSK9 inhibitor initiation and highlights the need for targeted microbiological evaluation and pharmacovigilance reporting. While the study is limited to a single case, the findings contribute to understanding potential adverse effects of tafolecimab.

abstract_zh: 背景 Tafolecimab 是一种全人源单克隆抗体,靶向前蛋白转化酶枯草杆菌蛋白酶/kexin 9 型 (PCSK9)。腹泻是一种公认​​的不良反应,但详细的上市后病例描述以及明确的时间、差异评估和结果仍然有限。病例摘要 一名因非 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死住院的 51 岁男性,于 2026 年 7 月 13 日 15:14 首次皮下注射 600 mg 的他福昔单抗 (SINTBILO)。约 7 小时 46 分钟后,他出现腹痛和腹泻,每天 5-8 次,伴恶心和轻度脐周疼痛,但无发热、里急后重,可见便血或黑便、脱水、低血压、反跳痛或戒备。粪便检查显示稀黄色粪便,潜血和红细胞阳性,白细胞0-1个/高倍视野,轮状病毒检测阴性;电解质及肝肾功能正常。未进行粪便培养和艰难梭菌、诺如病毒 和腺病毒检测。没有再次给予他福莱西单抗。补液、蒙脱石、盐酸洛哌丁胺后,腹泻在1天内减少,约2天后缓解,出院后未再复发。继续长期稳定的阿卡波糖治疗,未出现复发。Naranjo评分为5分,表明可能存在药物不良反应。结论 该病例支持可能与他福莱西单抗相关的急性腹泻。PCSK9 抑制剂启动后新发腹泻应提示精确的时间记录、药物协调、有针对性的微生物学评估和药物警戒报告。

title: A Multi-Epitope Immunogen Against Bovine Norovirus Combined with a Molecular Adjuvant Induces a Strong Immune Response in Mice
abstract: Bovine norovirus (BNoV) can cause acute diarrhea in calves and is highly contagious. Currently, no clinically effective therapeutic drugs are available, and vaccination is one of the most effective measures for controlling this infectious disease. In this study, a recombinant multi-epitope vaccine was constructed using a molecular adjuvant fusion design. In vitro safety assays showed that the recombinant protein at various concentrations exhibited no significant cytotoxicity to cells, and in vivo assessments indicated that the vaccine caused no pathological damage to major organs and induced no hemolytic reactions in experimental animals. The immunogenicity evaluation showed that the vaccine specifically induced high-titer IgG antibodies, significantly increased Th1-type cytokine levels, promoted splenocyte proliferation, and activated specific cytotoxic T lymphocytes (CTL) and helper T lymphocytes (HTL); moreover, it increased the proportion of CD4+ and CD8+ T cells. In conclusion, the recombinant protein vaccine developed in this study exhibited a satisfactory safety profile and elicited robust IgG and related cellular immune responses, providing important experimental evidence for the further development of a bovine norovirus vaccine.

title: Yield of a multiplexed gastrointestinal polymerase chain reaction panel for evaluation of diarrhea in hospitalized patients with cancer: a diagnostic stewardship opportunity
abstract: Abstract Background: Multiplexed polymerase chain reaction gastrointestinal panels (GIPs) include mostly community-acquired pathogens. Diagnostic yield of GIPs for detection of non- Clostridioides difficile targets in hospitalized patients with cancer with community versus hospital-onset diarrhea is not well defined. Methods: This cross-sectional study included stool tests from hospitalized adults with a cancer diagnosis from July 2021 to May 2025. Our center recommends a GIP primarily for patients with community-onset diarrhea and stand-alone C. difficile testing for hospital-onset diarrhea. Generalized estimating equations with Poisson regression were used to estimate the prevalence ratio (PR) of detecting ≥1 non- C. difficile target after hospital day (HD) 3 compared to HD 1–3. Results: Among 1,433 GIPs from 1,127 patients, 468 (33%) were ordered after HD 3. Most GIPs were among patients with hematologic malignancies (794/1,433; 55%) and of those tests 352/794 (44%) were ordered after HD 3. difficile and norovirus were detected most frequently (16% and 6%, respectively). difficile target was detected after HD 3 on 49/468 GIPs (10%), compared to 146/965 (15%) GIPs on HD 1–3 (adjusted PR 0.73; 95% CI [0.53–1.00]; P = .053). Among 49 GIPs after HD 3 detecting ≥1 non- C. difficile target, 19 tests were ordered for new-onset diarrhea and only 5 of these patients received intentional antimicrobial therapy in response to the GIP result. Conclusions: The added diagnostic yield for detecting ≥1 non- C. difficile target by GIP in patients with cancer and hospital-onset diarrhea is limited and supports restricting GIP ordering after HD 3 on oncology units.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to evaluate the diagnostic yield of multiplexed gastrointestinal polymerase chain reaction (GIP) panels for detecting non-Clostridioides difficile pathogens in hospitalized cancer patients with diarrhea, addressing a gap in understanding their utility in different clinical settings.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This cross-sectional study included stool tests from hospitalized adults with a cancer diagnosis from July 2021 to May 2025, focusing on patients with community versus hospital-onset diarrhea.
analysis.methods: The study used generalized estimating equations with Poisson regression to estimate the prevalence ratio of detecting ≥1 non-Clostridioides difficile targets after hospital day (HD) 3 compared to HD 1–3. The center recommends GIP primarily for patients with community-onset diarrhea and stand-alone C. difficile testing for hospital-onset diarrhea.
analysis.main_results: Among 1,433 GIPs from 1,127 patients, 468 (33%) were ordered after HD 3. difficile and norovirus were detected most frequently (16% and 6%, respectively). The prevalence ratio of detecting ≥1 non-C. difficile target after HD 3 was 0.73 (95% CI [0.53–1.00]; P = .053) compared to HD 1–3.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study found that the added diagnostic yield for detecting ≥1 non-C. difficile targets by GIP in patients with cancer and hospital-onset diarrhea is limited, suggesting a need to restrict GIP ordering after HD 3 on oncology units.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings inform diagnostic stewardship practices by highlighting the limited utility of GIPs for detecting non-C. difficile pathogens in hospitalized cancer patients with hospital-onset diarrhea, potentially reducing unnecessary testing and antimicrobial use.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is cross-sectional, which limits its ability to establish causality, and the evidence is based on observational data, resulting in moderate confidence in the findings.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the diagnostic yield of multiplexed gastrointestinal polymerase chain reaction (GIP) panels for detecting non-Clostridioides difficile pathogens in hospitalized cancer patients with diarrhea. It found that GIPs were less effective in identifying such pathogens after hospital day 3 compared to earlier days, with C. difficile and norovirus being the most frequently detected. The results suggest that the added value of GIPs in this context is limited, supporting the restriction of GIP testing after HD 3 on oncology units. The study's cross-sectional design and reliance on observational data result in moderate confidence in its findings, highlighting the need for further research to confirm these results and their implications for diagnostic stewardship in cancer patients with hospital-onset diarrhea.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在评估多重胃肠道聚合酶链反应 (GIP) 组合用于检测住院癌症腹泻患者中的非艰难梭菌病原体的诊断率,从而弥补对其在不同临床环境中的用途的理解差距。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项横断面研究包括 2021 年 7 月至 2025 年 5 月住院的患有癌症 诊断 的成人的粪便测试,重点关注社区与医院发病的腹泻患者。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用泊松回归的广义估计方程来估计住院第 3 天 (HD) 与 HD 1-3 天后检测到 ≥1 个非艰难梭菌目标的 患病率 比率。该中心建议主要对社区发病的腹泻患者进行 GIP,并对医院发病的腹泻患者进行独立的艰难梭菌检测。
elements_zh.main_results: 在来自 1,127 名患者的 1,433 个 GIP 中,468 个 (33%) 在 HD 3. difficile 和 诺如病毒 最常检测到(分别为 16% 和 6%)后被订购。患病率 检测非 C 的比率≥1。与 HD 1-3 相比,HD 3 后的艰难梭菌目标为 0.73 (95% CI [0.53-1.00];P = .053)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究发现,检测 ≥1 个非 C. 的诊断率有所增加。GIP 在癌症和院内腹泻患者中的艰难梭菌目标有限,这表明需要在肿瘤科 HD 3 后限制 GIP 排序。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现强调了 GIP 在检测非艰难梭菌方面的有限效用,为诊断管理实践提供了信息。住院癌症患者中发生院内腹泻的艰难梭菌病原体,可能减少不必要的检测和抗菌药物的使用。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是横断面的,这限制了其建立因果关系的能力,并且证据基于观察数据,导致研究结果的可信度中等。

title_zh: 用于评估住院癌症患者腹泻的多重胃肠道聚合酶链反应小组的产量:诊断管理机会
source_body_en: Abstract Background: Multiplexed polymerase chain reaction gastrointestinal panels (GIPs) include mostly community-acquired pathogens. Diagnostic yield of GIPs for detection of non- Clostridioides difficile targets in hospitalized patients with cancer with community versus hospital-onset diarrhea is not well defined. Methods: This cross-sectional study included stool tests from hospitalized adults with a cancer diagnosis from July 2021 to May 2025. Our center recommends a GIP primarily for patients with community-onset diarrhea and stand-alone C. difficile testing for hospital-onset diarrhea. Generalized estimating equations with Poisson regression were used to estimate the prevalence ratio (PR) of detecting ≥1 non- C. difficile target after hospital day (HD) 3 compared to HD 1–3. Results: Among 1,433 GIPs from 1,127 patients, 468 (33%) were ordered after HD 3. Most GIPs were among patients with hematologic malignancies (794/1,433; 55%) and of those tests 352/794 (44%) were ordered after HD 3. difficile and norovirus were detected most frequently (16% and 6%, respectively). difficile target was detected after HD 3 on 49/468 GIPs (10%), compared to 146/965 (15%) GIPs on HD 1–3 (adjusted PR 0.73; 95% CI [0.53–1.00]; P = .053). Among 49 GIPs after HD 3 detecting ≥1 non- C. difficile target, 19 tests were ordered for new-onset diarrhea and only 5 of these patients received intentional antimicrobial therapy in response to the GIP result. Conclusions: The added diagnostic yield for detecting ≥1 non- C. difficile target by GIP in patients with cancer and hospital-onset diarrhea is limited and supports restricting GIP ordering after HD 3 on oncology units.
abstract_zh: 摘要背景:多重聚合酶链反应胃肠道检测组合(GIP)主要包括社区获得性病原体。GIP 在社区癌症住院患者与院内腹泻患者中检测非艰难梭菌靶标的诊断率尚未明确。方法:这项横断面研究包括 2021 年 7 月至 2025 年 5 月住院的癌症 诊断 成人的粪便检测。我们中心建议主要对社区发病的腹泻患者进行 GIP,并对医院发病的腹泻进行独立的艰难梭菌检测。使用泊松回归的广义估计方程来估计与 HD 1-3 相比,在住院第 3 天 (HD) 后检测到 ≥1 个非艰难梭菌目标的 患病率 比率 (PR)。结果:在 1,127 名患者的 1,433 项 GIP 中,有 468 项 (33%) 在 HD 3 后进行。大多数 GIP 是在血液系统恶性肿瘤患者中进行的 (794/1,433;55%),其中 352/794 (44%) 在 HD 3 后进行。艰难梭菌和 诺如病毒 的检测频率最高(16% 和 6%,分别)。HD 3 后,49/468 个 GIP (10%) 检测到艰难梭菌靶标,而 HD 1-3 上检测到 146/965 (15%) GIP(调整后 PR 0.73;95% CI [0.53-1.00];P = .053)。在 HD 3 后检测到 ≥1 个非艰难梭菌目标的 49 名 GIP 中,有 19 名患者被安排进行新发腹泻检测,其中只有 5 名患者根据 GIP 结果接受了有意的抗菌治疗。结论:在癌症和院内腹泻患者中,通过 GIP 检测 ≥1 个非艰难梭菌目标的额外诊断率有限,并且支持在肿瘤科单位的 HD 3 后限制 GIP 排序。

title: Raman-Silent-Region Encoded SERS-LFIA for Low-Background and Sensitive Multiplex Detection of Heterogeneous Food Safety Hazards
abstract: Food safety hazards often coexist in complex matrices, creating a need for rapid, sensitive, and parallel detection of chemically and biologically distinct targets. However, current rapid detection methods are limited by low single-target efficiency, poor quantitative capability, and severe matrix interference. This study reports a Raman-silent-region encoded surface-enhanced Raman scattering-based lateral flow immunoassay (SERS-LFIA) platform for heterogeneous food safety hazards. Specifically, 4-mercaptobenzonitrile was confined at the interface between the Au core and Ag shell to construct the Raman-encoded nanoprobes. This configuration generated an intense and well-defined Raman response in the Raman-silent region (1800–2800 cm−1), thereby minimizing spectral interference and matrix-derived background signals and enabling sensitive and accurate detection. The nanoprobes were incorporated into a multiplex SERS-LFIA with three spatially separated test lines for the simultaneous detection of aflatoxin B1 (AFB1), norovirus genogroup I major capsid protein (NoV GI.1 VP1), and Salmonella Typhimurium (S. The limits of detection were 3.4 pg/mL for AFB1, 12.3 pg/mL for NoV GI.1 VP1, and 1.02 × 104 CFU/mL for S. In spiked real samples, recoveries ranged from 85.48% to 111.95% in tea, and 86.09% to 112.03% in soymilk. Overall, the proposed multiplex SERS-LFIA integrates Raman-silent-region encoding, interfacial confinement within a core–shell architecture, and spatial discrimination across multiple test lines. This integrated design suppresses matrix-derived background, improves quantitative sensitivity, and enables concurrent analysis of chemically and biologically distinct food safety hazards, providing a new approach for rapid screening in complex food samples.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a novel Raman-silent-region encoded SERS-LFIA platform for the simultaneous detection of multiple food safety hazards, including norovirus genogroup I major capsid protein. The method uses nanoprobes with 4-mercaptobenzonitrile confined at the Au-Ag interface to generate unique Raman responses, minimizing interference and enabling sensitive detection. The platform was tested in spiked tea and soymilk samples, achieving recovery rates between 85.48% and 112.03% for the targets. The study highlights the potential of this approach for rapid screening in complex food matrices, though the evidence is based solely on abstract data, limiting its strength to moderate. The findings could inform improved surveillance and risk assessment for food safety.

title_zh: 拉曼静音区域编码 SERS-LFIA 用于异质食品安全危害的低背景和灵敏多重检测
source_body_en: Food safety hazards often coexist in complex matrices, creating a need for rapid, sensitive, and parallel detection of chemically and biologically distinct targets. However, current rapid detection methods are limited by low single-target efficiency, poor quantitative capability, and severe matrix interference. This study reports a Raman-silent-region encoded surface-enhanced Raman scattering-based lateral flow immunoassay (SERS-LFIA) platform for heterogeneous food safety hazards. Specifically, 4-mercaptobenzonitrile was confined at the interface between the Au core and Ag shell to construct the Raman-encoded nanoprobes. This configuration generated an intense and well-defined Raman response in the Raman-silent region (1800–2800 cm−1), thereby minimizing spectral interference and matrix-derived background signals and enabling sensitive and accurate detection. The nanoprobes were incorporated into a multiplex SERS-LFIA with three spatially separated test lines for the simultaneous detection of aflatoxin B1 (AFB1), norovirus genogroup I major capsid protein (NoV GI.1 VP1), and Salmonella Typhimurium (S. The limits of detection were 3.4 pg/mL for AFB1, 12.3 pg/mL for NoV GI.1 VP1, and 1.02 × 104 CFU/mL for S. In spiked real samples, recoveries ranged from 85.48% to 111.95% in tea, and 86.09% to 112.03% in soymilk. Overall, the proposed multiplex SERS-LFIA integrates Raman-silent-region encoding, interfacial confinement within a core–shell architecture, and spatial discrimination across multiple test lines. This integrated design suppresses matrix-derived background, improves quantitative sensitivity, and enables concurrent analysis of chemically and biologically distinct food safety hazards, providing a new approach for rapid screening in complex food samples.
abstract_zh: 食品安全危害通常共存于复杂的基质中,因此需要快速、灵敏且并行地检测化学和生物学上不同的目标。然而,目前的快速检测方法受到单目标效率低、定量能力差、基质干扰严重的限制。本研究报告了一个拉曼沉默区编码的基于表面增强拉曼散射的侧流免疫分析(SERS-LFIA)平台,用于检测异质食品安全危害。具体来说,4-巯基苯甲腈被限制在金核和银壳之间的界面处,以构建拉曼编码的纳米探针。这种配置在拉曼静音区域 (1800–2800 cm−1) 产生强烈且明确的拉曼响应,从而最大限度地减少光谱干扰和基质衍生的背景信号,并实现灵敏且准确的检测。将纳米探针整合到具有三个空间分离的测试线的多重 SERS-LFIA 中,用于同时检测黄曲霉毒素 B1 (AFB1)、诺如病毒 基因组 I 主要衣壳蛋白 (NoV GI.1 VP1) 和鼠伤寒沙门氏菌 (S)。AFB1 的检测限为 3.4 pg/mL,NoV GI.1 VP1 的检测限为 12.3 pg/mL,S 为 1.02 × 104 CFU/mL。在加标的实际样品中,茶中的回收率为 85.48% 至 111.95%,豆奶中的回收率为 86.09% 至 112.03%。总体而言,所提出的多重 SERS-LFIA 集成了拉曼沉默区编码、核壳结构内的界面限制以及跨多个测试线的空间辨别。抑制基质衍生的背景,提高定量灵敏度,并能够同时分析化学和生物学不同的食品安全危害,为复杂食品样品的快速筛查提供新方法。

title: Ionic-liquid-tailoring of membranes for selective virus removal in sustainable wastewater treatment
abstract: Low-pressure microfiltration (MF) membranes are generally ineffective for enteric virus removal because membrane pores are substantially larger than virus particles. Here, electrospun poly(vinylidene fluoride-co-hexafluoropropylene) (PVDF-HFP) membranes were functionalized with ionic liquids (ILs) to create selective pathogen-removal platforms. Four pyrrolidinium bis(trifluoromethylsulfonyl)imide ([NTf2]) ILs with increasing cation alkyl-chain lengths (C3–C8; IL3, IL4, IL6 and IL8) were systematically compared to establish structure–performance relationships governing membrane stability and pathogen removal. A lower-toxicity cholinium-based IL (ChIL) was also evaluated. All IL-modified membranes achieved >5 log reduction value (LRV) for influenza A virus (IAV). For murine norovirus (MNV), IL3 achieved >3.1 LRV under single-virus conditions, whereas IL6 provided >5 LRV in mixed IAV–MNV filtration. ChIL-modified membranes achieved >5 LRV for both MNV and IAV. Under crossflow filtration, ChIL membranes provided up to 3.4 LRV for Escherichia coli , compared with ~1 LRV and substantial flux loss for a commercial PVDF membrane. These results demonstrate that low IL loadings can impart strong pathogen selectivity, with ChIL offering a promising balance of performance, stability and environmental compatibility.

Data Availability Statement: The data that support the findings of this study are not publicly available due to patient privacy and confidentiality restrictions but are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request. The authors declare no use of generative AI or AI-assisted tools in this manuscript. Longer survival and cumulative treatment exposure in multiple myeloma (MM) have increased the clinical relevance of coexisting myelodysplastic syndrome (MDS) and acute myeloid leukemia (AML), including therapy-related myeloid neoplasms. Prior cytotoxic therapy and selection of susceptible clones during lenalidomide exposure contribute to this risk.1˒2 These dual diagnoses create intersecting treatment constraints: impaired hematopoiesis can limit MM therapy, myeloid-directed treatment can compound cytopenias and infection risk, and persistent cytopenias may reflect either malignancy or treatment toxicity. B-cell maturation antigen (BCMA)-targeted therapies, like teclistamab, have shown high efficacy in RRMM across pivotal clinical trials, including MajesTec-1, -3, and -9.3,4,5 However, these clinical trials excluded patients with MDS and other active malignancies, leaving limited evidence for this population. We describe six selected teclistamab recipients with MM and MDS/AML diagnosed before or after treatment initiation, focusing on treatment delivery, MM response, and myeloid disease course. We retrospectively reviewed patients treated at the University of Pennsylvania, between January 1, 2023, and December 31, 2025, who had: (1) RRMM requiring therapy, (2) a diagnosis of MDS or AML, and (3) receipt of at least one dose of teclistamab. Clinical data were abstracted from the electronic medical record, including demographics, prior MM therapies, cytogenetic and molecular features of MM and MDS/AML, laboratory parameters at teclistamab initiation, infectious complications, transfusion requirements, and treatment responses. Myeloma responses were assessed per IMWG criteria. Myeloid disease risk was categorized according to IPSS-M when applicable.6 This study was deemed exempt and patient consent was waived by the University of Pennsylvania Institutional Review. Six male patients (aged 70-86 years) met criteria. Median prior lines of therapy was 6.5. Four were penta-class exposed and two were triple-class exposed. Patients 1 and 2 had previously received idecabtagene vicleucel. Three patients were diagnosed with MDS/AML before initiating teclistamab, while the remaining were diagnosed after therapy initiation. The interval from MM diagnosis to MDS/AML diagnosis varied, with a median of 46.8 months (range 0–132.8 months). Four patients had very low or low IPSS-M risk disease, and one had moderately high-risk features. Patient 3, who was treated as AML, was classified as adverse risk per European LeukemiaNet (ELN) 2022/2024 less-intensive criteria.7,8 Median follow-up from teclistamab initiation was 24.0 months (range 10.8–38.8 months). Cytopenias were common, and patients 1–3 required temporary teclistamab holds for worsening counts. Management of MDS/AML included observation or supportive care, azacitidine for patient 1, azacitidine plus venetoclax for patient 3, and luspatercept for patient 6 (Table 1). All patients received antiviral, Pneumocystis prophylaxis, and intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIG) to maintain IgG levels > 400 mg/dL. Documented infections included recurrent pneumonia, rhinovirus/enterovirus, COVID-19 and chronic norovirus-associated diarrhea (Table 2). All patients achieved at least a very good partial response (VGPR) or better during initial teclistamab course; patient 3 also received palliative radiation. Five stopped treatment after a median of 9.6 months (range 6.5-18.1 months): two enrolled in a limited-duration teclistamab trial (NCT05932680)9, two due to cytopenias requiring transfusions, and one because of recurrent infections. Patient 6 continued teclistamab with a complete response (CR). Patients 1, 3 and 4 restarted teclistamab after MM progression. CR was reported after retreatment in patients 1 and 3, whereas patient 4 progressed three months after restarting. Patient 2 died from progressive MM after switching therapy. Five of six patients demonstrated stable MDS throughout the period of teclistamab exposure. Patient 1 developed high-risk MDS approximately 11 months after teclistamab initiation and progressed to AML approximately 15 months later. No other myeloid progression was reported. In this single-center series, teclistamab produced deep MM responses in six selected patients with MDS or AML diagnosed before or after treatment initiation. These dual diagnoses create competing therapeutic demands: controlling MM while preserving limited hematopoietic reserve and managing a second marrow malignancy. Cytopenias and infections constrained treatment delivery despite MM responses, illustrating that disease control and treatment tolerance must be assessed separately. Selection bias is the principal limitation of these observations. Patients with rapidly progressive MDS/AML, those requiring urgent induction chemotherapy or allogeneic transplantation, and those dying before a subsequent MM relapse would be unlikely to receive teclistamab. This series therefore preferentially captures patients who survived and remained suitable for MM- directed therapy; four of the five patients with MDS had very low or low IPSS-M risk. Moreover, three myeloid diagnoses were established after teclistamab initiation. Their earlier exposure cannot demonstrate feasibility in patients with known active MDS/AML at treatment initiation. The findings should therefore be interpreted as a descriptive experience in selected patients rather than evidence of safety across the broader population with dual diagnoses. The mechanisms underlying cytopenias in this setting are likely multifactorial, including impaired hematopoiesis from either malignancy, cumulative treatment exposure, concurrent myeloid-directed therapy, and treatment-associated inflammation. Clonal hematopoiesis and inflammatory signaling have been associated with hematologic toxicity and secondary myeloid neoplasms after BCMA-directed CAR T-cell therapy,10˒11 but their contribution during bispecific-antibody treatment remains uncertain. Without systematic pretreatment marrow assessment and myeloid sequencing, we cannot determine whether diagnoses made after teclistamab reflected previously unrecognized disease or subsequent clonal evolution. Although uniform myeloid progression was not observed, the heterogeneous trajectories do not establish that teclistamab leaves myeloid disease biology unaffected. Similarly, patient 1’s progression from MDS to AML cannot be compared with the natural history of MDS without an appropriate comparator. Myeloid-associated immune dysregulation provides an additional rationale for studying this population because it could affect the efficacy of both CAR T cells and bispecific antibodies. The observed MM responses demonstrate that teclistamab activity can occur despite coexisting myeloid disease, but do not establish preserved T-cell function or resistance to immune dysfunction. A practical distinction is that teclistamab does not require lymphodepleting chemotherapy, which may be difficult to deliver in patients with substantial marrow failure. Its ongoing administration also permits treatment holds for cytopenias or infections. These considerations do not establish superiority over CAR T-cell therapy. Reports of secondary myeloid neoplasms after BCMA-directed CAR T-cell treatment are complicated by prior cytotoxic exposure and pre-existing clones,10˒11 and this series cannot determine whether the corresponding risk differs with bispecific antibodies. Management requires close collaboration between myeloma and leukemia teams to identify the cause of cytopenias, prioritize treatment, coordinate therapies, and individualize transfusion and infection support, consistent with the experience reported by Hochman et al.12 Persistent or worsening cytopenias warrant reassessment for myeloid disease rather than automatic attribution to teclistamab. Antimicrobial prophylaxis, immunoglobulin replacement, and careful monitoring remain central to treatment delivery. Limited-duration teclistamab is under prospective investigation,9 but these cases cannot establish whether treatment discontinuation reduces infections or preserves durable MM control in patients with concurrent MDS/AML. In addition to selection bias, the small sample size, retrospective design, incomplete molecular profiling, and heterogeneous myeloid-directed treatment limit interpretation. The absence of a comparator precludes conclusions about relative efficacy, toxicity, or myeloid progression. Teclistamab achieved MM responses in these selected patients, while cytopenias and infections remained important treatment constraints. Prospective studies should distinguish pre-existing from subsequently diagnosed MDS/AML, characterize baseline myeloid risk and clonal evolution, and capture outcomes among patients unable to receive MM-directed therapy. Garfall,2 Adam D. Cohen,2 Shivani Kapur,2 Catherine E. Lai,2 Selina M. Luger,2 Edward A. Stadtmauer,2 Dan T. Vogl,2 Adam Waxman,2 Sandra P.
